title: Relax Within, Balance Across: Load Balancing under Composition Shifts in Vision-Language Mixture-of-Experts
abstract: arXiv:2608.00574v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Vision-language mixture-of-experts (MoE) models such as Qwen3-VL need balanced loads for fast parallel serving. Standard training pools image and text tokens into one auxiliary loss, assuming training balance holds at inference. Yet we find a surprising mismatch: on a fixed router, balance shifts sharply whenever resolution, dynamic tiling, or image count changes the image-to-text token ratio. Splitting load by modality reveals cross-modal load cancellation: opposing image and text errors cancel near the training ratio, hiding strong skew until the mix changes. To quantify this shift, we derive an exact quadratic law: under fixed modality profiles, one reference run predicts the full response curve, and the image-text gap governs sensitivity. Meanwhile, patches within an image route similarly while patch counts vary, letting large images dominate flat pooling. We propose ReBA (Relax Within, Balance Across) to separate modality

translated_title: 内部放松，跨模态平衡：视觉语言混合专家模型中组合偏移下的负载均衡
translated_abstract: 像Qwen3-VL这样的视觉语言混合专家模型需要均衡的负载以实现快速并行服务。标准训练方法将图像和文本词元合并到同一个辅助损失中，并假设训练时的负载均衡在推理时依然保持。然而我们发现了一个令人惊讶的不匹配现象：在固定路由器上，只要分辨率、动态平铺或图像数量改变了图像与文本词元的比例，负载均衡就会发生急剧偏移。按模态拆分负载揭示了跨模态负载抵消现象：相反方向的图像和文本误差在训练比例附近相互抵消，掩盖了强烈的负载偏斜，直到混合比例发生变化才会暴露。为了量化这种偏移，我们推导出一个精确的二次定律：在固定的模态分布下，仅需一次参考运行即可预测完整的响应曲线，且图像-文本差距决定敏感度。同时，同一图像内的图像块以相似方式路由，而图像块数量各不相同，使得大图像在简单池化中占据主导地位。我们提出ReBA（内部放松、跨模态平衡）方法来分离模态（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文揭示了视觉语言混合专家模型中的跨模态负载抵消现象——图像与文本误差在训练比例附近相互抵消从而掩盖推理时的负载失衡，并提出ReBA方法通过模态内放松、模态间平衡的策略来应对组合偏移下的负载均衡问题。
en_tdlr: The paper reveals cross-modal load cancellation in vision-language MoE models, where opposing image and text routing errors mask severe load imbalance until the token mix shifts, and proposes ReBA to relax balancing within each modality while balancing across modalities.
